domain: Professional Basketball Team Performance and Analytics
scenario:
A major professional basketball league is developing a comprehensive analytics and management system to track and analyze the performance of its teams throughout the season. The system will provide detailed statistics and insights on team performance metrics, player contributions, game outcomes, and fan engagement. This platform is intended to support league officials, team managers, coaches, and analysts in making data-driven decisions to enhance team strategies, improve player performance, and optimize fan experiences.

The system must handle a wide array of statistics, including offensive and defensive efficiencies, shooting percentages, turnovers, rebounds, and more advanced metrics such as effective field goal percentage and true shooting percentage. Each team will have detailed records of their games, including attendance figures, special plays, and rule violations. The platform will also track player movements, such as signings and trades, and provide insights into team dynamics and roster changes.

Additionally, the system will feature tools for analyzing game trends and predicting playoff outcomes based on seed numbers and historical performance. It will also include advanced reporting capabilities and dashboards for visualizing team and player data. This will enable stakeholders to assess performance trends, identify areas for improvement, and engage with fans through enhanced statistical insights and interactive experiences.
